(J. McKay). If G is a finite group and p a prime let m (G) denote the number
                                                               p
of ordinary irreducible characters of G whose degree is not divisible by p. Let P be a
Sylow p-subgroup of G. Is it true that mp (G) = mp (NG (P ))?              J. B. Olsson
  ∗ Yes, it is true (M. Cabanes, B. Späth, Preprint, 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/
2410.20392)
